name: @logly-uk/mcp

tools.name: logly_list_sites
tools.description: List every website in the authenticated Logly account with its site ID. Start here to find the site ID the other tools need.

tools.name: logly_stats
tools.description: Traffic totals for a site — pageviews, sessions, visitors, bounce rate, average duration — plus a daily series and a comparison against the previous period.

site.description: Logly site ID (slug). Call logly_list_sites to discover it.

days.description: Days to look back: 7, 30 or 90. Defaults to 30. Ignored when 'from'/'to' are set.

from.description: Range start, YYYY-MM-DD. Use together with 'to'.

to.description: Range end, YYYY-MM-DD. Use together with 'from'.

tools.name: logly_breakdown
tools.description: Top pages, top referrers, top countries and device/browser split for a site over the given period.

site.description: Logly site ID (slug). Call logly_list_sites to discover it.

days.description: Days to look back: 7, 30 or 90. Defaults to 30. Ignored when 'from'/'to' are set.

from.description: Range start, YYYY-MM-DD. Use together with 'to'.

to.description: Range end, YYYY-MM-DD. Use together with 'from'.

tools.name: logly_realtime
tools.description: Visitors currently active on a site (real-time, the last few minutes).

site.description: Logly site ID (slug). Call logly_list_sites to discover it.

tools.name: logly_events
tools.description: Custom event counts for a site (events sent via logly('event', ...)) over the given period.

site.description: Logly site ID (slug). Call logly_list_sites to discover it.

days.description: Days to look back: 7, 30 or 90. Defaults to 30. Ignored when 'from'/'to' are set.

from.description: Range start, YYYY-MM-DD. Use together with 'to'.

to.description: Range end, YYYY-MM-DD. Use together with 'from'.

tools.name: logly_funnels
tools.description: List the conversion funnels defined for a site, with their IDs and step sequences.

site.description: Logly site ID (slug). Call logly_list_sites to discover it.

tools.name: logly_funnel_results
tools.description: Completion counts and drop-off per step for one conversion funnel.

days.description: Days to look back: 7, 30 or 90. Defaults to 30. Ignored when 'from'/'to' are set.

tools.description: Return the Logly tracking snippet for a site — the single <script> tag to add to the site's <head>. Works offline, no API call.
